quote: Except for a motor vehicle, no person shall park any vehicle on any street for a period of time longer than thirty minutes between the hours of one a.m. and six a.m. of any day.

activation.description: A person parks a qualifying nonmotor vehicle on a reviewed street during the civil nighttime interval.
activation.source_clause: Except for a motor vehicle, no person shall park any vehicle on any street

obligation.description: Retain the source-observed continuous duration and compare to the exact statutory threshold without claiming a verdict.
obligation.source_clause: for a period of time longer than thirty minutes

exceptions.description: Motor vehicle class is excluded; original legal classification required.

timing.description: Original civil-clock samples inside 01:00–06:00 of any day; endpoints need independent review.
timing.source_clause: between the hours of one a.m. and six a.m. of any day

judgment_calls_needed.note: Independent legal vehicle and propulsion class review; blueprint is insufficient.
Responsible person, parking purpose and actual stillness require source review.
Public street access, jurisdiction and original on-street position require review.

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-measured continuous seconds below/at/above thirty minutes
